watch.summary: A streamer wildly celebrates a Valorant round victory only to immediately collapse into his chair in shame as the casters reveal a bizarre team buy.

beats.what: Streamer chants and shakes a spray bottle celebrating a round win.
Streamer pops into frame yelling that he is back and never left.
Casters point out a questionable four-Guardian buy, causing the streamer to slump over in his chair.
Streamer slowly peeks back over the desk looking worried and defeated.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The contrast between his over-the-top hype flex and his immediate head-in-hands head slump provides great visual irony. Without understanding Valorant round economies, a casual viewer might miss why the moment goes so downhill.
